_comment: Mutations for the two follow-ups on the fork-screener-ws-config branch.
O7-O9 break the client that uses it (bot_module/data_consumer.py).
3a -- docker-startup.sh swallowing a failed database migration.
S1-S5 break the CRITICAL report or change the container's behaviour.
NOTE on the target: the 3b tests live in tests/test_fork_screener_ws_config.py
and the 3a tests live in tests/test_docker_startup_migration_failure.py, so
BOTH are named. The 3a test needs bash and is skipped on native Windows;
this harness runs pytest under WSL, where it executes.
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

mutations.label: O1: the Origin falls back to the UPSTREAM's reserved hostname
O2: the Origin ignores the CONFIGURED host and always names this fork's own domain
mutations.replace: host = FORK_OWN_DOMAIN  # MUTANT: the configured host is ignored

mutations.label: O3: the scheme is not mapped the way a browser maps it (ws:// stays ws://)
mutations.replace: http_scheme = "https" if scheme == "wss" else "ws"  # MUTANT: not mapped

mutations.label: O4: a DEFAULT port is kept in the Origin (https://host:443)
mutations.needle: if port is not None and port != default_port:
mutations.replace: if port is not None:  # MUTANT: a default port is kept

mutations.label: O5: a NON-default port is dropped from the Origin
mutations.needle: if port is not None and port != default_port:
mutations.replace: if False:  # MUTANT: the port is always dropped

mutations.label: O6: a URL that is not a WebSocket URL is accepted as the Origin
mutations.needle:
if scheme not in ("ws", "wss"):
        return fallback
mutations.replace:
if False:  # MUTANT: a non-WebSocket URL is accepted
        return fallback

mutations.label: O7: the client hardcodes the UPSTREAM's Origin again
O8: the client sends a CONSTANT Origin instead of a derived one
O9: the client derives the Origin from the UPSTREAM's URL
S1: the failed migration is reported as a WARNING again
mutations.needle: echo "CRITICAL: the database migration FAILED (the 'alembic upgrade head' step exit code ${migration_status})." >&2
mutations.replace: echo "WARNING: the database migration FAILED (alembic upgrade head exit code ${migration_status})." >&2

mutations.label: S2: the CRITICAL report no longer names the migration's exit code
mutations.needle: echo "CRITICAL: the database migration FAILED (the 'alembic upgrade head' step exit code ${migration_status})." >&2

mutations.label: S3: the CRITICAL report goes to stdout instead of stderr
mutations.needle: echo "CRITICAL: the database migration FAILED (the 'alembic upgrade head' step exit code ${migration_status})." >&2
mutations.replace: echo "CRITICAL: the database migration FAILED (alembic upgrade head exit code ${migration_status})."

mutations.label: S4: the failed migration now STOPS the container from starting the application
mutations.needle:
echo "CRITICAL: check the migration output above, fix the migration, and restart this container." >&2
fi
mutations.replace:
echo "CRITICAL: check the migration output above, fix the migration, and restart this container." >&2
    exit 1
fi

mutations.label: S5: the failed migration is swallowed completely (no report at all)
mutations.needle:
migration_status=$?
    echo "CRITICAL: the database migration FAILED (the 'alembic upgrade head' step exit code ${migration_status})." >&2

mutations.label: O10: an IPv6 literal is not bracketed, so the Origin is not a URL
mutations.needle: authority = f"[{host}]" if ":" in host else host
mutations.replace: authority = host  # MUTANT: an IPv6 literal is not bracketed

mutations.label: O11: the Origin names the UPSTREAM when the operator points the feed at it
